Introduction
------------

This vignette demonstrates the multi-day reference experiment workflow using
the stable scenario API. It runs Experiment B (grazer vs browser vs mixed),
then inspects the generated summary table and plot artefacts.

Run a reference experiment
--------------------------

```r
exp_b <- herbivoreTTR::run_experiment_b_functional_types()
summary_b <- utils::read.csv(exp_b$summary_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
summary_b
```

Inspect generated artefacts
---------------------------

Experiment B writes a stable bundle to:

```r
exp_b$run_dir
list.files(exp_b$run_dir)
```

You can load the report markdown and manifest metadata:

```r
manifest <- jsonlite::read_json(exp_b$manifest_path, simplifyVector = TRUE)
manifest[c("schema_version", "run_id", "scenario_slug", "seed")]

report_lines <- readLines(exp_b$report_path)
report_lines[1:12]
```

Plot quick visual checks from the summary table:

```r
op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 2, 1))

plot(
  summary_b$strategy,
  summary_b$grass_share,
  type = "b", pch = 19, col = "forestgreen",
  xlab = "Strategy", ylab = "Grass share",
  main = "Diet composition by strategy"
)

barplot(
  height = summary_b$final_browseable_biomass_kg,
  names.arg = summary_b$strategy,
  col = c("#4f772d", "#bc6c25", "#6a994e"),
  ylab = "kg",
  main = "Final browseable biomass"
)
par(op)
```

Run the paper skeleton
----------------------

```r
if (nzchar(Sys.which("quarto"))) {
  paper_html <- herbivoreTTR::render_paper_pipeline_report()
  paper_html
} else {
  "Quarto not detected; skipping paper render in this vignette run."
}
```

Notes
-----

- Reference experiments are intentionally short-horizon and mechanism-focused.
- For larger sweeps, provide custom scenario YAMLs and execute with
  `run_scenario_v1()`.
- The release workflow bundles these same artefacts under
  `artefacts/release_candidates/`.
